messages.text: Fed held, statement a touch more hawkish on the dots. 2s backed up like 6 bps, equities giving back the morning bid. Watch the tape into the close.
SPX lost 25 handles in about 90 seconds. Bids thin out in the futures. Financials holding up better than tech though.
Phones are lighting up. Real money wants to sell into the bounce, a few hedge funds asking for color on vol. Anyone seeing size in VIX calls?
Yeah, saw a decent 30 delta VIX call buyer print about two minutes after the statement. Looks like hedging, not a punt.
Heads up, spreads are wide on the small caps. I'm slicing the VWAP orders thinner until it settles. OMS is showing a couple of child orders sitting unfilled.
Fine, don't chase. Use limits, participation cap at 8% until the presser starts.
Powell's tone in the presser is softer than the statement. Reversing the tech weakness, QQQ off the lows. Whipsaw city.
Told you. Now the same accounts that wanted to sell are asking to buy back. Love it.
Can you send me the axes on the bank names? Two clients want to lean into the rally.
Sending now. Regionals are the cleanest, we're axed long in a few of them.
TradeBlotter P&L looks stale for me, last refresh 14:21. Anyone else seeing that or just my screen?
Mine updated a minute ago. Hard refresh and re-pull the layout. If it's still stuck, ping IT in #it-ops.
Refresh fixed it. Thanks. Back to the MOC imbalances, looks like a sell skew into the close.
